description: This source file defines the class CheckUnrestrictedPermissionsVisitor, which extends CheckPermissionsVisitor. It is responsible for visiting resource nodes and aggregating permissions, particularly checking for unrestricted permissions, within a resource permission checking framework. The class appears to be part of an enforcer or policy validation system related to permissions in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: CheckUnrestrictedPermissionsVisitor
classes.description: A final class extending CheckPermissionsVisitor, responsible for checking and aggregating permissions for resource nodes with special handling for unrestricted permissions.
